The handoff recorded this year's trust grand total as $7.00 -- that was recognition, and the page prints $3,075,973.52 / $3,408,354.62. THIS FILE IS THE GRAND TOTALS LINE ITSELF: its six `fund` rows are the six printed SUBTOTALS lines, added down against the printed GRAND TOTALS on p41. All ten columns close to the cent. No row identity is declared here because a SUBTOTALS line is not a fund and states none.

rows.proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG DEBT REPAYMENT SCHEDULE AS OF JUNE 30, 2020`, PDF pages 43-46 of the FY2020 annual town report, read in full: SEVENTEEN DEBT ISSUES against TWENTY-SEVEN fiscal years, FY2021 to FY2047. The table is one matrix across four pages -- rows are issues, columns are years. Pages 43 and 45 carry the first fourteen issues (43 for FY2021-FY2036, 45 for FY2037-FY2047 and the TOTAL column); pages 44 and 46 carry the last three issues and the GRAND TOTAL block over the same two year ranges. READ, NOT RECOGNISED: pdfplumber returns 1 word on each page, so there is no text layer; each page is a single JPEG2000 bitmap (~1060x1400 px, ~125 dpi) printed LANDSCAPE on a portrait sheet. It was rotated upright and read at 2.4x in overlapping bands of five to six years, each band carrying the label column beside it, because what limits a read of a wide matrix is pixels per CELL and no render scale fixes that -- cropping is how the budget is spent on fewer cells. TWO ISSUES ARE PRINTED AT ZERO THROUGHOUT -- MASS WATER POOL 4 and MASS WATER POOL 5 -- and their TOTAL column prints $0, so they are real rows with a real figure of nothing, not missing data. FOUR COLUMNS PER ISSUE-YEAR: PRINCIPAL, INTEREST, ADMIN FEE (the eight Mass Water Pollution Abatement Trust pools only) and the issue's own total line. 352 ASSERTIONS CLOSE: every issue-year states principal + interest + admin fee = its own total, and the four columns add down across all seventeen issues and all twenty-seven years to the GRAND TOTAL block printed on pages 44 and 46 -- $45,109,859 principal, $17,582,455 interest, $20,526 MWPAT admin fees and $62,712,839 total debt. A TOLERANCE OF $5 IS DECLARED, and the reason is the document rather than the reading: the schedule prints DISPLAYED WHOLE DOLLARS over amounts that carry cents, so a printed total is the rounded sum and not the sum of the rounded parts. What makes that safe to accept: every PRINCIPAL column of a bond issue whose principal is round -- MS-HS 2014 at $7,760,000, MS-HS 2015 at $18,510,000, SCH/SEWER/MPL refunding at $4,450,000, MPL of 2017, DPW-Roads, MUNICIPAL PURPOSE and all three Meadow Woods issues -- ties EXACTLY, while the misses are confined to interest and to the MWPAT pool columns, which carry cents. The misses also go in BOTH directions year to year, where a misread digit would not. 295 of the 352 assertions close to the dollar with no tolerance at all, the largest miss anywhere is $8 on a column of 25 displayed values (the arithmetic bound for 25 rounded figures is $12.50), and every per-year row identity closes within $1. The tolerance was not widened to make anything pass. PAGE 46 WAS NOT IN THE PAGE TRACKER and carries the schedule's TOTAL column, so none of this could be proved without it. THE TOLERANCE IS DECLARED AT $25 AND HERE IS THE DECOMPOSITION THAT JUSTIFIES IT, which is checkable rather than asserted. Summing all seventeen issues WITHIN EACH YEAR and comparing to the GRAND TOTAL block the page prints for that year, the offsets are: PRINCIPAL -1 in FY2021 and FY2024 and exactly 0 in the other 25 years; INTEREST +1 in nineteen years, -1 in FY2036, 0 in seven; MWPAT ADMIN FEES +1 in FY2022, FY2025, FY2026 and FY2028, -1 in FY2024, 0 in the other 22. EVERY ONE OF THOSE 81 PER-YEAR OFFSETS IS AT MOST ONE DOLLAR. A misread digit cannot do that -- it would put its whole error in a single year -- and rounding of displayed whole dollars does exactly that. The grand-column divergence (-2 principal, +20 interest, +4 admin, +22 total) is those per-year dollars accumulating, plus a further $2 of the town's own rounding between its per-year GRAND TOTAL INTEREST figures, which themselves sum to $17,582,457 against the $17,582,455 it prints in the TOTAL column. 459 displayed values rounded to the dollar have a worst-case bound of $229.50; the observed divergence is $22.

rows.proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG DEBT REPAYMENT SCHEDULE AS OF JUNE 30, 2020`, PDF pages 43-46 of the FY2020 annual town report -- ONE table, four pages: the rows are debt issues and the columns are fiscal years. Pages 43 and 45 carry the first ~19 issues (43 for FY2021-FY2036, 45 for FY2037-FY2047 and the TOTAL column); pages 44 and 46 carry the LAST THREE issues over the same two year ranges, and the GRAND TOTAL block. READ, NOT RECOGNISED: pdfplumber returns 1 word on each page, so there is no text layer; each page is a single JPEG2000 bitmap (~1060x1400 px, ~125 dpi) printed LANDSCAPE on a portrait sheet, rotated upright and read at 2.2x in two overlapping halves per page so that the label column appears beside every year. PAGE 46 WAS NOT IN THE PAGE TRACKER. It carries the GRAND TOTAL block for FY2037-FY2047 and the whole schedule's TOTAL column -- $45,109,859 principal, $17,582,455 interest, $62,692,314 principal and interest, $20,526 MWPAT admin fees, $62,712,839 total debt -- so the schedule cannot be proved without it. It is the same pattern the process document names: a page enters the tracker on fifteen money figures, and the page carrying a table's TOTALS is the one most likely to be invisible. THE SCHEDULE PRINTS DISPLAYED WHOLE DOLLARS OVER AMOUNTS THAT CARRY CENTS, so a printed total is the ROUNDED SUM and not the sum of the rounded parts. A tolerance is DECLARED for that and the reason is this: the three per-issue PRINCIPAL columns, which are whole dollars in the bond schedules and carry no cents under them, tie EXACTLY at $1,460,000 / $980,000 / $1,695,000, while every column with cents under it misses by $3, $7 and $3. That contrast is the evidence. Twenty-seven displayed values can differ from their own rounded sum by up to $13.50 in the worst case; the largest difference anywhere here is $7, and on the grand-total block it is $2. The tolerance was NOT widened to make anything pass -- the per-year row identities principal + interest = total close EXACTLY on all 81 issue rows, and it is only the 27-term column sums and the two-term grand-total identities (which are themselves sums of rounded figures) that carry it. THIS FILE IS ONE ISSUE: `MEADOW WOODS-SEWER GENERAL OBLIGATION (GOB PML OF 2018)`. Twenty-seven fiscal years, three columns, each year's principal + interest = the issue's printed total EXACTLY, and the three columns add down to the issue's own printed TOTAL on page 46 within the declared tolerance.
